3. Workload assumptions (5.0, 13.0): Please publish expected package volume by 20x Class and pathway (20x and Rev5) and target review cycle times, including how the Rev5/20x mix will shift across the option years as Rev5 phases down. These drive the labor mix and price.
4. AI tools (2.0, 3.3): Please define "super-intelligence tools" and confirm whether they are Government-furnished, and whether contractor-provided AI tools may be used with package data.
5. Access and GFI (12.0): Please list required systems, repositories, and expected suitability and PIV timelines, since ramp-up depends on them.
6. Labor categories (5.0, 6.0): Consider adding a Machine-Readable Compliance / Automation Engineer category to match the Automation Lead key role.
7. Key personnel (6.0): Limiting key personnel to three roles (Task Lead, 20x Technical Lead, QA Lead) would broaden competition.
8. Comparable experience (6.0): Please treat independent federal security assessment, audit evidence review, and agency ATO package review as comparable to FedRAMP package review.
9. Transition (9.0): Please confirm the anticipated start date relative to the current task order's end so transition-in can be planned.
10. OCI (11.0): Please define disqualifying relationships (FedRAMP Recognized assessor work, CSP advisory, CSP resale), whether a lookback period like REC-IAS-SEP's two years applies, and the disclosure and mitigation path.
